title: Essais, self-édition, Volume I (Livre I + Livre II ch. 1-6)
author: Michel de Montaigne
edition: Général Michaud's 'self-édition' (Firmin-Didot, Paris, 1907), based on the 1595 posthumous Marie de Gournay edition. Preserves period orthography: 'L'orthographe a été conservée.' The edition interleaves original text and Michaud's modern-French translation by book block (not sentence). The original section spans lines 1268-15102; Michaud's translation of the same material starts at line 15103 and is excluded from this ingest.
notes: Contains original text of Livre I (all chapters) and Livre II chapters 1-6. Vol II (Gutenberg #49168) has Livre II ch. 7-35; Vol III (#58801) has Livre II ch. 36+ and Livre III. Original orthography features u/v interchange (diuers, esmouuoir, auoit), i/j interchange (iustice, iettans), -ez participle endings, and -oit imperfect endings.
